description: After fz-kdt.48.1 (every provably empty descriptor interns to none) a clause pinning two or more closure literals can never survive interning: MergeSig for ArrowSig merges every literal pair that can name one value, so a surviving multi-literal clause names at least two distinct brands and func_clause_empty calls it empty. The multi-literal fallback in the callable runtime-test projection (the arm the old test a_multi_literal_callable_clause_admits_every_capture_layout_of_its_targets exercised) therefore has no interned input. Delete the fallback and its tests; if a reader still constructs such a clause outside intern, make it go through intern. Signal: the projection has one arm per reachable clause shape and a test proves a two-brand clause is the bottom.
title: Multi-literal callable clause fallback is unreachable from an interned Ty
